question: What minimum off-roadway sizes does Table 9A-1 give for a STOP sign, a YIELD sign, and a Crossbuck sign on a bicycle facility?
model_answer: Direct Answer: For signs installed specifically on bicycle facilities (off-roadway applications such as shared-use paths), Table 9A-1 gives a minimum size of 18 x 18 inches for the STOP (R1-1) sign, 18 x 18 x 18 inches for the YIELD (R1-2) sign, and 24 x 4.5 inches for the Grade Crossing Crossbuck (R15-1) sign. These minimum sizes are mandatory for bicyclist-specific installations. Standards (mandatory): - "The minimum sign and plaque sizes for signs specific to bicycle-only facilities and shared-use paths shall be those shown in Table 9A-1. These sizes shall be used only for signs and plaques installed specifically for bicyclist applications." - Table 9A-1 (Sheet 1) lists: Stop, R1-1, Section 9B.01, Off Roadway 18 x 18; Yield, R1-2, Section 9B.01, Off Roadway 18 x 18 x 18; Grade Crossing (Crossbuck), R15-1, Section 9B.23, Off Roadway 24 x 4.5. Guidance (recommended): - The text of Table 9A-1 reproduced under Section 9A.03 confirms the entries "Stop R1-1 9B.01 18 x 18 —" and "Yield R1-2 9B.01 18 x 18 x 18 —" in the Off Roadway column. Visual evidence: - [Image 5] shows Table 9A-1 (Sheet 1 of 3), listing Off Roadway minimums of 18 x 18 for the Stop sign (R1-1), 18 x 18 x 18 for the Yield sign (R1-2), and 24 x 4.5 for the Grade Crossing (Crossbuck) sign (R15-1), with a roadway size of 48 x 9 for the Crossbuck. - [Image 4] shows Figure 9B-1 (Sheet 1 of 2) depicting the STOP (R1-1) and YIELD (R1-2) signs as regulatory signs for bicycle facilities. - [Image 3] shows Figure 9B-1 (Sheet 2 of 2) depicting the RAILROAD CROSSING Crossbuck (R15-1) sign among regulatory signs for bicycle facilities. Citations: - Table 9A-1 (p.1036) - Section 9A.02 Standard §10 (p.1048) - Section 9A.03 Guidance §3 (p.1051) - Page 1090 - Page 1093 - Page 1094
gold_answer: STOP: 18 x 18 inches; YIELD: 18 x 18 x 18 inches; Crossbuck: 24 x 4.5 inches.
